summary: Iter174 — Validated the New-Collaboration wizard rework on /tools/collaborate (Step 1 module chips + step picker + step-wise share-step launch) + 'Verify Identity' gating + Jitsi de-brand + backend POST /api/shared-steps/create for all three modules (decision, pros_cons, solution_finder). Backend: 6/6 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter174_collab_wizard_rework.py — POST /api/shared-steps/create returns 200 with {id, shared_count>=1, link} for module=decision (async, step 7), module=pros_cons (async, step 3) and module=solution_finder (async, step 2); session_mode='live_sync' is persisted on the share; GET /api/shared-steps/{id} carries the new session_mode + auth_config fields; GET /api/shared-steps/{id}/review returns 200 (no 500) and exposes module/step_number for every module. Validation: missing module_id ⇒ 400, empty recipient_emails ⇒ 400. Frontend (mobile 390x844, web, super@test.com): the + header button opens the redesigned 'New Collaboration' modal whose Step 1 reads 'Choose flow & step' with three module-type chips (MyDezider, Pros & Cons, Solution Finder); tapping each chip correctly filters the flow list AND keeps the step picker hidden until a flow is selected; selecting a MyDezider flow reveals the 7-step chip row ('Which step needs input?' + Frame…Decide); Next is blocked twice — alert 'Pick a flow and the step to collaborate on' shown both (a) when no flow chosen and (b) when flow chosen but no step. Step 2 (Mode) shows the 'Decision Making Mode' title with the two checkboxes 'Notify participants about invitation' and 'Disclose decision making mode to participants' visible above the mode list (above the fold). Scroll resets to top between steps via createScrollRef.scrollTo({y:0}) on next/back. /tools/collaborate page text contains NO occurrence of 'Jitsi' (verified PAGE_HAS_JITSI: False). For the live-sync join card, the source reads 'Video call • Screen sharing on' (collaborate.tsx:704). 'Verify Identity' gating in the session-detail modal is conditional on (detailSession.auth_requirements?.enabled_methods || detailSession.auth_config?.enabled_methods || []).length > 0 (collaborate.tsx:817) — correctly hides the dead-end button for sessions with no method enabled. Presence Check (Seconds) field is wrapped in `sessionMode === 'live_sync'` (collaborate.tsx:410) — hidden for async. No console errors during the flow (only the chronic RN-Web shadow* + props.pointerEvents deprecation warnings).

ui_bugs.component: collaborate.tsx startCreate() — Solution Finder flow loader
ui_bugs.issue: Line 137 calls api.get('/solution-finder') (singular) which returns 404 — backend tools.py exposes /api/solution-finders (plural). Net effect: when the user picks the 'Solution Finder' module-type chip, the flow list will be empty (or only show flows the SF API happens to also return), so SF launches from the wizard are NOT usable end-to-end. The other two endpoints (/decisions, /pros-cons) are correct. Fix: change line 137 to api.get('/solution-finders'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/collaborate.tsx:137

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/solution-finder 404 — see ui_bugs item; SF flow list never populates in the wizard.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web warning 'shadow*' style props are deprecated; use 'boxShadow' — chronic across many components (not iter174-specific).
RN-Web warning props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents — chronic.

action_items: (HIGH) Fix /app/frontend/app/tools/collaborate.tsx:137 — change api.get('/solution-finder') to api.get('/solution-finders') (plural). Backend tools.py exposes /solution-finders; the wrong route returns 404 and the Solution Finder chip's flow list never populates from the wizard.
(CHRONIC) Replace deprecated RN-Web 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: collaborate.tsx Step 1 (lines 210-257): MODULE_TYPES chips + STEP_CATALOG correctly drive moduleTypeFilter and step picker is gated on selectedModule, so the picker only appears after a flow is selected — matches PRD.

collaborate.tsx Next handler (line 752-757) blocks via showAlert('Required','Pick a flow and the step to collaborate on') when (!selectedModule || selectedStep === null) on Step 0, and (selectedContacts.size === 0) on Step 2 — verified live.

collaborate.tsx handleCreate (line 154-184) calls POST /shared-steps/create with module/module_id/step_number/recipient_emails/merge_mode/session_mode/auth_config/notify and routes the owner into the chosen module on success — matches backend contract.
collaborate.tsx line 817 — 'Verify Identity' is correctly gated on auth_requirements/auth_config enabled_methods length > 0, eliminating the dead-end button.
collaborate.tsx line 410 — Presence Check (Seconds) only renders when sessionMode === 'live_sync'.
Jitsi de-brand: no 'Jitsi' substring exists in collaborate.tsx — the join card label reads 'Video call • Screen sharing on' (line 704).

Backend sharing.py /shared-steps/create (line 148-224): correctly persists session_mode + auth_config + call_room_url on the share doc and dispatches in-app + email + WhatsApp best-effort, returning {id, shared_count, invited_count, link}.
seed_data_creation: Test created (and self-cleaned) one decision, one P&C and one SF for share-create assertions; one extra decision share created for the live_sync session-mode persistence check. Note: 4 share docs left in db.shared_steps (no DELETE /shared-steps/{id} route exists per iter172 action item) — harmless, owned by super@test.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: pytest backend/tests/test_iter174_collab_wizard_rework.py — uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL automatically (falls back to /app/frontend/.env). Frontend: super@test.com / SuperPass2026! → /tools/collaborate → tap + at mouse(355,32) → wizard modal opens (testIDs not yet added to chips/cards but text selectors work: 'MyDezider', 'Pros & Cons', 'Solution Finder', 'Frame', 'Next'). The two non-blocking observations are: (a) collaborate.tsx chips/cards lack testIDs (text selectors are reliable for now), (b) RN-Web deprecation warnings are chronic.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Every iter174 acceptance criterion verified (module chips filter, step picker gating, Next-blocking alerts, notify checkboxes above-the-fold, async/live presence-check gating, Verify-Identity gating, Jitsi removed, shared-steps/create accepts the three modules and persists session_mode + auth_config, /review carries no 500).
